relations.subject: capella:index-ui-status
relations.evidence: Status | The current state of the Index Service on the node where this index is stored. The possible statuses include **ready**, **pause**, or **warmup**.

notable_absence.finding: Neither of the two known recurring anomalies appears on this page: no Enterprise/Community edition badge, and no server-version-string citation (e.g. 'Server version 7.x+'). The page is purely UI-procedural (Capella Indexes page) and defers all version/edition-sensitive statement syntax to the linked SQL++ reference pages instead of restating it here.

cross_component_finding: This page delegates index DDL entirely to the Query tab/SQL++ layer rather than exposing its own create/alter mechanism - the Capella UI's only index-management-specific vocabulary is the read-only Indexes-page summary/performance-statistics view and its own Status enum (ready/pause/warmup), which is a genuinely different vocabulary from the DDL-lifecycle index-state enum (scheduled for creation/deferred/building/pending/online/offline/abridged) promoted in the server/ statement-reference rounds. The two enums describe overlapping but distinct things - one is a per-index DDL-creation lifecycle, the other a per-node/per-replica runtime health status - and no page in the corpus so far reconciles them.
